# Cheatsheet

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-cheatsheet.sh — DO NOT edit by hand. -->

> Generated from the config's real keymaps (`nvim_get_keymap`, `menus/`, `servers/on_attach.lua`).
> Regenerated automatically on every commit (`.githooks/pre-commit`). `<leader>` = `Space`.
> This is the ONLY source of keys. What can't be derived from code (what each thing does, workflows, tools): [`docs/cheatsheets/`](docs/cheatsheets/README.md).

## Leader menus

Each menu has its own letter under `<leader>` and only exists where it applies: when pressing `<leader>`
which-key only shows what belongs to the current buffer.

## Autocompletion (blink.cmp, insert mode)

Preset `enter` plus the overrides from `plugins/editing/blink.lua`. `→` = tried in order until one applies.

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `<C-b>` | scroll documentation up |
| `<C-e>` | close menu |
| `<C-f>` | scroll documentation down |
| `<C-k>` | show signature help → hide signature help |
| `<C-n>` | next item |
| `<C-p>` | previous item |
| `<C-space>` | open menu → show documentation → hide documentation |
| `<CR>` | accept Go `ErrX` ghost text + new line → accept item |
| `<Esc>` | close menu |
| `<S-Tab>` | previous item → jump to previous snippet placeholder (when no menu is open) |
| `<Tab>` | accept Go `ErrX` ghost text → next item → jump to next snippet placeholder (when no menu is open) |

| `<A-v>` | n,t | Toggleable vertical term |
| `<C-x>` | t | Escape terminal mode |

### Textobject

| Key | Mode | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `<End>` | n,x | Block end (End) |
| `<Home>` | n,x | Block start (Home) |
| `<PageDown>` | n,x | Next block (PageDown) |
| `<PageUp>` | n,x | Previous block (PageUp) |
| `[f` | n,x,o | Previous function |
| `]f` | n,x,o | Next function |
| `ac` | x,o | Outer class |
| `af` | x,o | Outer function |
| `ic` | x,o | Inner class |
| `if` | x,o | Inner function |

### Window

| Key | Mode | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `<C-h>` | n | Window left |
| `<C-j>` | n | Window down |
| `<C-k>` | n | Window up |
| `<C-l>` | n | Window right |

## Native Neovim 0.11 (not from this config)

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `grn` | rename symbol |
| `gra` | code action |
| `gri` | go to implementation |
| `grt` | go to type definition |
| `gO` | document symbols |
| `K` | hover (documentation) |
| `gx` | open the URL or path under the cursor |
| `gc / gcc` | comment (operator / line) |
